         serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio, cliente, rfc, fecha, total, ref1, status
  FROM faccab
  ORDER BY serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'), fcaptura DESC
) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vigentes f WHERE f.status = 'V' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clientes c WHERE c.clave = f.cliente)

WITH ultimas AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'))
           serie,
           LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0') AS folio,
           cliente,
           status
    FROM faccab
    ORDER BY serie, LPAD(TRIM(numfac), 10, '0'), fcaptura DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS facturas_vigentes_sin_cliente
FROM ultimas f
WHERE f.status = 'V'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM clientes c
      WHERE c.clave = f.cliente
        AND c.status <> 'B'
  )
